title: Equipment
description: Weapons, armor, and adventuring gear. Shields reuse the armor sub-object for DR stats but are distinguished by type and slot=offhand; they provide no passive DR and only apply during active block/parry.

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id) for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

weapon.description: Melee and ranged weapons. Weapons have two primary classification axes: (1) damage.type (slashing/bludgeoning/piercing maps to the blades/blunt/piercing combat skills), and (2) length (short/normal/reach) which also controls attackReach in 'units of length' (reach = 2 units). short + normal are typically one-handed; reach weapons are two-handed. Each weapon declares its governing 'skill' and 'attackReach'. Base damage uses classic D&D 3.5-style dice. Material-based variations and crafting restrictions are documented in docs/modules/weapons.md rather than enforced in the base schema.

length.description: Physical length / engagement category of the weapon. Determines both handedness and attack reach in discrete 'units of length'. short and normal weapons are typically one-handed and attack 1 unit. Reach weapons are two-handed and can attack 2 units of length. One of the two primary weapon classification axes (the other being damage.type, which maps to blades/blunt/piercing skills).

skill.description: The skill used to make attack rolls with this weapon. For melee this is normally derived from damage.type (slashing → blades, bludgeoning → blunt, piercing → piercing). Ranged weapons use one of the split archery skills (bows, crossbows, guns, or throwing_weapons).

attackReach.description: How many units of length this weapon can attack in melee. Most weapons (short/normal) have 1; reach weapons have 2. This is determined by the length category but stored explicitly for clarity.

armor.description: An armor piece (or shield) that covers a specific slot and layer. Each piece provides base damage reduction (drBase) modified by the crafting material's modifiers.defense. Shields use slot 'offhand' and layer null (they do not layer on body and provide DR only during active block).

slot.description: Body slot this piece occupies. 'offhand' is for shields.

layer.description: Layering position. null for shields (offhand, no body layering) and some back items. Required for torso/head/hands/feet armor.

category.description: Governing skill for this piece. Omit for back/on_top items (no skill requirement).

drBase.description: Base damage reduction before material modifier. Summed across all worn pieces per incoming physical hit.

evasionPenalty.description: Penalty to evasion skill while worn. light 0, medium −5, heavy −15.

speedPenalty.description: Movement speed reduction in units. light 0, medium −1, heavy −2.

strengthRequirement.description: Minimum STR attribute required to wear effectively (1–10 range).

stealthPenalty.description: Whether this piece imposes stealth penalties.

requiresLayer.description: Layer dependency. e.g. 'middle' layer requires a 'skin' layer in the same slot.

consumable.description: A consumable or applied item (potion, poison, coating, oil, food) whose effects are drawn from the shared effect registry.

delivery.description: How the item is used: drink/eat (self), apply_weapon (poisons/coatings/oils), throw (bombs)

uses.description: Number of applications/charges; e.g. a weapon coating may last several hits

accessory.description: A wearable magical or decorative item. Up to 5 accessories may be worn simultaneously, one per type.

accessoryType.description: The kind of accessory. Only one of each type can be worn at a time.

effects.description: Magical effects provided by this accessory.
